official_title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE COMMISSION TO THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT, THE COUNCIL, THE EUROPEAN ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL COMMITTEE AND THE COMMITTEE OF THE REGIONS Building Trust in Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence
short_title: Building Trust in Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence

institution_roles.evidence_locator: Document masthead and title block: 'EUROPEAN COMMISSION' and 'COMMUNICATION FROM THE COMMISSION'.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: The communication links the AI HLEG ethics framework to the Commission's human-centric policy approach and public piloting process.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: Analytical selection, separate from the official EUR-Lex metadata.

document_date.locator: Document masthead immediately above the title: 'EUROPEAN COMMISSION'; 'Brussels, 8.4.2019'; 'COM(2019) 168 final'.
document_date.meaning: The dated Commission masthead establishes 8 April 2019 as the issue date of the final communication.

publication_date.locator: Page heading 'Communication: Building Trust in Human Centric Artificial Intelligence', metadata line 'Publication 08 April 2019', and description naming COM(2019)168.
publication_date.meaning: The Commission publication page independently establishes first official publication on 8 April 2019.

classification_evidence.locator: Title and sections 1-2, especially the paragraphs beginning 'Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential' and 'The purpose of this Communication is to launch a comprehensive piloting phase'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The communication substantively addresses trustworthy, human-centric AI and launches implementation testing of ethical guidance for AI development and use.

classification_evidence.locator: Section 1 opening paragraph, which enumerates healthcare, energy, cars, farming and natural resources, climate, financial risk, manufacturing, fraud, cybersecurity, and law enforcement uses of AI.
classification_evidence.rationale: The opening scope spans numerous public and private domains and is not confined to a single sector.

classification_evidence.locator: Document masthead and title block: 'EUROPEAN COMMISSION' and 'COMMUNICATION FROM THE COMMISSION'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The official text identifies the European Commission as the issuing authoring institution.

classification_evidence.locator: Metadata line 'Publication 08 April 2019' and description identifying COM(2019)168.
classification_evidence.rationale: An official Commission publication page identifies the publication date and exact official reference.
